Template.Name: Shelly Plug S Gen3 MQTT
Template.Description:
Shelly Plug S Gen3 uses the Gen2+ RPC MQTT API (JSON payloads), not the Gen1 "shellies/<id>/relay/0" plain-text topics.
Device setup: open http://<shellyIpAddress> -> Settings -> Connectivity -> MQTT. Enable MQTT, fill in "Server" as {MQTT broker IP}:{port} (and user/password if your broker requires them). Leave "Enable RPC over MQTT" ticked - that is how this template switches the output. Tick "RPC status notifications over MQTT" and "Generic status update over MQTT" so the device publishes both the events/rpc and status/... topics. Note that MQTT and the Shelly Cloud connection are mutually exclusive.
"Plug topic (MQTT prefix)" is the value of the "MQTT Prefix" field on that same page, entered exactly as configured and without a trailing slash. Set it to shellies/<your device name>, for example shellies/shellyplug-s-kitchen. The device then publishes to <plug topic>/status/switch:0, <plug topic>/events/rpc and <plug topic>/online, and accepts commands on <plug topic>/rpc.
The module subscribes to the root topic shellies/#, so all Shelly devices sharing that prefix arrive on one subscription; every message is then matched against the plug topic above, and other devices are ignored. If the plug uses the factory prefix (the device ID, shellyplugsg3-<deviceid>) instead of a shellies/ one, either change the prefix in the device to shellies/<name>, or after import change the module's Root topic to <plug topic>/#.
